```{r, eval=TRUE}
library(tidyverse)
library(tinytable)
library(modelsummary)

vars <- c(
  # DEMAND
  "population_m",
  "percent_workers_nonprofit",
  "percent_workers_self_employed",
  "percent_workers_private_sector",
  "percent_workers_government",
  "percent_education_bachelor_or_higher",
  "percent_public_assistance_or_snap_households",
  # CAPACITY
  "state_leg",
  "new_member",
  # "first_two", #FIXME make this numeric in replication and cm
  "experience",
  "chair",
  "ranking_minority",
  "subchr",
  "staff_count_intergovernmental",
  "staff_count_constituent_casework",
  # "same_party",  #FIXME make this numeric in replication and cm
  "oversight",
  # INCENTIVES 
  "competitive",
  "competitive_primary",
 # "est_total_spending",
 # "est_staff_spending",
 # "est_legis_spending",
 # "est_pol_spending",
 # "est_comm_spending",
 # "est_constit_spending",
  "majority",
  "presidents_party",
  "party",
  #"far_left",
  "far_right",
  "agency_ideo",
  "distance",
  "abs_nominate_dim1",
  "nominate_dim1",
  # OTHER
  "PACamount_m",
  "lesclassic"
  #"chamber",
  #"year",
)

load(here::here("data", "total", "data_member.rda"))

dcounts |>
  # mutate(distance = abs(nominate_dim1 - agency_ideo),
  #        same_party = as.numeric(same_party),
  #        first_two = as.numeric(first_two),
  #        population_m = population_total/1000000,
  #        est_total_spending = est_total_spending/1000000) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  select(any_of(vars) ) |>
  modelsummary::datasummary_skim(
    fun_numeric = list(
    `% Missing` = PercentMissing,
    Min = Min,
    Mean = Mean,
    Max = Max,
    SD = SD,
    Histogram = function(x) "") )  |> 
  # multipage (requires fake header for caption hack)
    tinytable::theme_latex(multipage = TRUE) |> 
   # bold header, hline bottom, aligned center
  tinytable::style_tt(j = 1, align = "l") |>
  tinytable::style_tt(i = 0, bold = T, line = "b") |>
  tinytable::style_tt(fontsize = .8)
```
